verdict.rationale: Google endpoint management is first-party and built into the same platform. It covers mobile devices, desktops and laptops, and documents policy enforcement (password requirements), account wipe from mobile devices, and actions on lost devices. Context-Aware Access ties app access to user identity and device security status. Community reports say full device verification depends on Chrome's Endpoint Verification, which is a limitation rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the device enrollment flow, explicit remote lock capability, and independent hands-on corroboration of wipe and policy enforcement.

support.subject: As an IT admin, devices are managed from the same platform or a documented MDM integration — enrollment, policy enforcement, and remote lock/wipe tied to identity

citations.quote: With Google endpoint management, you can make your organization's data more secure across your users' mobile devices, desktops, laptops, and other endpoints.
Wipe a user's account from a mobile device
Set password requirements for managed mobile devices
you can create granular access control security policies for apps based on attributes, such as user identity, location, device security status, and IP address
